Future<void> stream(dynamic stream, dynamic items) async {
  await for (final item in stream) {
    await save(item);
    for (final child in items) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(child);
    }
  }
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(item);
  }
  await ready(); for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(item);
  }
  await /* stream */ for (final item in stream) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(item);
  }
}
